# Gate question 1: the brainstorm gate, visit 1

- Asked: Can Herald of Blood's explosions spread the bleed to the next pack?
- Agent: build-guide-researcher

## Answer

No. Herald of Blood's explosion, on killing an enemy with Blood Loss, deals Physical Attack damage to the enemies around it and "has a chance to Aggravate Bleeding": it makes a bleed already on them worse. Nothing in the text inflicts Blood Loss or Bleeding, so a fresh pack still needs Blood Hunt's hits first (confirmed in game text).

## Sources

- lookup_game_data gem "Herald of Blood": "killing an enemy with Blood Loss will cause a bloody explosion that deals Physical Attack damage to surrounding enemies … and has a chance to Aggravate Bleeding"
- lookup_game_data gem "Blood Hunt": "Hitting an enemy that has suffered Blood Loss will cause a blood explosion and also Consume Bleeding"
